name: NiceVault
description: Fills user names, passwords and 2FA codes from your NiceVault volumes. Talks only to the app on this computer.
cmd_open: Open the NiceVault menu in the field
st_missing: NiceVault is not installed on this computer (the portable version does not connect to browsers).
st_sandbox: If this browser is installed as a Flatpak or Snap, it is sandboxed and cannot talk to NiceVault.
st_absent: “{name}” is on a stick that is not plugged in.
st_waiting: Type the password in NiceVault's window.
st_lookalike: Warning: this site looks like {of} but it is not.
st_insecure: This page is not secure (http): the password could be read.
st_version_app: Update NiceVault to use this extension.
st_unsupported: This browser is too old to connect to NiceVault safely.
st_no_volumes: No volume known on this computer.
note_form_action: This form sends its data to {host}.
note_mismatch: This entry is for {entry}; you are filling on {page}.
note_copied: Copied. The clipboard is cleared in {s} seconds.
note_covered: The page covered the menu: nothing was filled.
note_rate: Too many requests in a minute: try again shortly.
note_never: This login is set to "Never fill": NiceVault does not fill it.
note_use_popup: To fill this anyway, use the NiceVault button in the toolbar.
pair_intro: Once for this browser profile. The code below must be the same one NiceVault's window shows: confirm there.
pair_confirm_in_app: Confirm in NiceVault that the code is the same.
pair_done: Connected. You can close this tab.
pair_busy: NiceVault is already asking to connect another browser.
pair_blocked: NiceVault blocked connection requests for 10 minutes.
pair_rule: A volume's password is typed only in NiceVault's window, never in a web page.
opt_launch_hint: NiceVault starts only after a click of yours, never when a page opens.
opt_memory: Remember which volume holds each site
opt_memory_hint: Used to suggest the right volume to unlock. It stays in this browser profile and only says that you have a NiceVault login for that site.
opt_copy_totp: Copy the 2FA code after logging in
opt_permission_hint: Firefox asks for permission to show the icon in the sites' login fields.
help_install: The extension talks only to the NiceVault app installed on this computer. Install NiceVault (not the portable version), open it once and keep “Connect browsers” on in Settings → Browser.
help_sandbox: Browsers installed as Flatpak or Snap cannot start programs of the computer: use your system's own build of the browser (deb/rpm package or from its website).
help_limits: Limits: malware running as you while a volume is unlocked can read what NiceVault fills; filled values are in the page; some forms drawn on a canvas or inside closed shadow roots are not recognised (the toolbar menu still works).
